name: Vitality

name: Bargain Hunter
description: Equipment can be purchased at 95% of their base price.

name: Festival of Blood
description: Gain 6% Spell Vamp. Each hero kill or assist grants an additional 0.5% Spell Vamp, up to 12 stacks.

name: Master Assassin
description: If there is only one enemy hero nearby, damage dealt to them is increased by 7%.

name: Pull Yourself Together
description: Cooldowns of Battle Spells and equipment's active skills are reduced by 12% initially. Each hero kill or assist grants an additional 1% reduction, up to 8 stacks.

name: Seasoned Hunter
description: Damage against Lord and Turtle is increased by 15%. This bonus is halved against regular Creeps and doesn't

name: Tenacity
description: When HP is below 50%, Damage Reduction is increased by 5%.

name: Weapon Master
description: Physical Attack and Magic Power gained from equipment, emblem, talents, and skills are increased by 8%.

name: Wilderness Blessing
description: Movement Speed in the Jungle and River is increased by 10%. This bonus is halved when in combat with enemy heroes, Lord or Turtle.

name: Brave Smite
description: Brave Smite: Dealing skill damage to an enemy hero recovers 5% Max HP. CD: 6 seconds.

name: Concussive Blast
description: After the next Basic Attack, deal 100(+7% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Cooldown: 15s.

name: Focusing Mark
description: After damaging an enemy hero, allied heroes deal 6% more damage to them and gain 10% Movement Speed. Duration: 3 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds.

name: Impure Rage
description: Dealing damage with skills deals 4% of target's Max HP extra Adaptive Damage and restores 2% Mana on hit. (If the hero does not use Mana, restores 1% HP instead. The extra Adaptive Damage dealt to non-hero units is up to 120. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

name: Killing Spree
description: When damaging heroes below 30% HP, instantly recover 15% of Lost HP and gains 20% Movement Speed. Additional Effect: Reset cooldown upon killing an enemy hero. Duration: 3 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

name: Lethal Ignition
description: Dealing damage greater than 7% of an enemy hero's Max HP 3 times within 5s will scorch the target for an additional 162-750 Adaptive Damage (scales with level). Cooldown 15 seconds.

name: Quantum Charge
description: Dealing damage with Basic Attacks increases Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s and restores 75-180 HP (scales with level). Cooldown: 10 seconds.

name: Temporal Reign
description: The next Ultimate cast decreases other active skills' remaining cooldowns by 1.5 times within 4 seconds. This effect is extended by 2 seconds after getting hero kills or assists. (This only applies to the hero themselves. Cooldown: 20 seconds.)

name: War Cry
description: After every 3 separate Basic Attacks or skills hit an enemy hero, all damage dealt increases by 8% for 6 seconds. (A single Basic Attack or skill that deals damage multiple times only counts as 1. Cooldown: 6 seconds.)

name: Weaknes Finder
description: Basic Attacks slow enemies by 50% and reduce their Attack Speed by 30%. Duration: 1 second. Cooldown: 10 seconds (each Basic Attack reduces it bv 1 seconds, down to 3 seconds).
